The sea never keeps the truth forever, child. It gives food to our tables, but demands total humility in return. Restore what was forgotten.
Young men look at the horizon and see adventure. Old fishermen like me look at the clouds and pray. Listen to the ocean's quiet whisper.
When I was young, an elder taught me: never curse a small catch. The sea gives what God allows. Look closely at our shore.
Our hands are calloused from pulling nets, yet our hearts remain tender for our children. Search the village—the old ways still linger.
You cannot fight the tide, my friend. You can only respect its power and remember those who rowed before us.
